method: Read exact published package metadata and module imports; do not install or execute Radix.
blocker: The required package needs React and ReactDOM; adding them violates the inherited no-React condition. Its React component API cannot be directly used as a Vue component.
hybrid_note: Keeping Vue alone does not prevent a React island. An explicit Vue-to-React adapter and both React runtimes could be developed if the no-React condition changed.
